cases.task: Spin the wheel to initiate a gameplay session.
cases.expected: The wheel spins, stops at a segment, and displays the prize won without any errors.

cases.task: View the list of available prizes before spinning the wheel.
cases.expected: A complete and accurate list of prizes is displayed, matching the set prizes available on the wheel.

cases.task: After spinning the wheel, navigate to the section displaying user winning records.
cases.expected: The user's winning record is updated to include the latest prize won, with correct details on date and prize.

cases.task: Verify that the website uses 'ivory' as the background color and 'dark green' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
cases.expected: The website has a background color of 'ivory' and components (such as buttons, cards, headers, etc.) are styled with the color 'dark green', accurately reflecting the design instruction.

cases.task: Open the prize management page, add a new prize named 'Golden Ticket', then go back to the prize list and the wheel.
cases.expected: The prize 'Golden Ticket' appears in the prize list and as a segment of the wheel, and the prize can be removed again from the management page.
